# Build One Thing

> Build One Thing is a matchmaker for your business. A free mini quiz gives overwhelmed, non-technical people strong initial direction that's theirs to keep. A $199 one-time Full Plan (not open yet) adds about 90 more questions and a deep analysis of gifts, values, optional faith and season of life, then delivers one top business pick plus two backups, a step-by-step plan, a 30-day starter roadmap and ready-to-paste AI build prompts for Grok Bot or any builder. Refinement credits included. No income or results are promised.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://buildonething.com/): What Build One Thing is, how it works, example plans, and the free mini quiz
- [Free quiz](https://buildonething.com/#quiz): Easy questions about your time, work and hobbies, with one clear direction and the reasons for it
- [Full Plan](https://buildonething.com/#join): The $199 one-time Full Plan, and a list to join. Not open yet; clicking charges nothing.
- [FAQ](https://buildonething.com/#faq): Plain answers about what the $199 includes, optional faith questions, what happens after, and why no income is promised

## Example plans (samples, not real customers)

- [The Aging Parent Navigator](https://buildonething.com/plans/aging-parent-navigator/): A calm guide for adult children in the first 90 days of caring for a parent.
- [The Second-Act Expert](https://buildonething.com/plans/second-act-expert/): Turning 20 years of work skills into part-time consulting for small businesses.
- [Faith & Purpose Devotional Studio](https://buildonething.com/plans/devotional-studio/): Topical devotionals and small-group studies, sold on Amazon and to churches.

## Who it's for

- [For beginners](https://buildonething.com/easy/): A plan for starting one online business with no tech skills
- [For real estate agents](https://buildonething.com/agents/): A side business idea for real estate agents
- [For a side business](https://buildonething.com/side/): Finding one side business that fits your hours

## Guides

- [All guides](https://buildonething.com/guides/): Plain, honest guides for overwhelmed beginners
- [Too many side hustle ideas? How to pick one](https://buildonething.com/guides/too-many-side-hustle-ideas/): A step-by-step way to narrow many ideas down to one
- [Easy online business for beginners over 50](https://buildonething.com/guides/online-business-over-50/): Simple, low-cost ideas that use life experience, plus scam warnings
- [How to choose an online business with no experience](https://buildonething.com/guides/how-to-choose-an-online-business/): Five questions to choose one business that fits your time and skills

## Facts

- Status: early. The quiz is free and live. The Full Plan is not open yet; people can join a list.
- Price: $199, one time, for the Full Plan. No subscription.
- Faith and values questions are optional.
- Build One Thing does not build or run the business. The user builds it with Grok Bot or any AI builder and owns everything.
- No promises or predictions of income. Most new online businesses earn little or nothing for months, and many never do.
